findings.text: gate.DATA_LINES[:] = [list(zip(xs, counts))] hands the step trace's vertices to the shared guard, whose sampler (section_row_readers.py:_samples) interpolates straight lines between consecutive vertices, while ax.step(..., where="post") draws a horizontal run across each interval; a label sitting on a horizontal step run is reported clean (verified: counts [5,0,0] with a label at data (0.5,5) passes _check), so the over-data half of the gate is weaker for this figure than for a line plot.

VERDICT done_when: the done_when names a mean of at least 12, a median completion-to-promotion of at most 20 minutes, no shared-root claim hold with the total passes and every held path's root, under 100 identity files, and a §9-window negative control; docs/evidence/fragments/work-flows-to-the-lane/work-flows-to-the-lane-s67.census.json records mean 1.15 over 12 spans, median 1876.0 s over 5 of 5, 0 of 496 passes holding a shared-root claim with the one held path and its root '.', 1 identity file, and census-s9window.json/census-s9window-now.json record the control's three latter figures unmet (5,654.0 s over 38 of 39, 5 of 8 passes, 27,854 identities at that window's close).
